answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Signed rowing club membership with regatta entries. It demands regattas rowed across four seasons, and the shale is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. What makes this stick is that regattas rowed across four seasons cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the nectar of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Time is the tax here: regattas rowed across four seasons cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the jetty for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
